blocks.text: Match preview: England face Sri Lanka in 3rd T20I (T20) on Sat, 19 Sept, 2026, 7:00 pm at Emirates Old Trafford Manchester. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Classic English seaming conditions when clouds cover; batting paradise in sunshine.
Drizzle · High 20°C / Low 16°C · Rain: 1.2 mm · Wind: up to 25 km/h. Light rain possible — overcast conditions could assist swing bowling early.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
